# Cloudflare AI Web

> Open-source, self-hostable AI chat built on Cloudflare Workers AI and Cloudflare AI Gateway. One codebase deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Vercel or Docker; the server is stateless and conversations stay in the visitor's browser.

## Features

- Chat with Cloudflare Workers AI models, whose availability and capabilities come from the Cloudflare account's live model catalog.
- External models (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and other providers) routed through Cloudflare AI Gateway with BYOK, Unified Billing or Gateway Routes, declared with `CF_AI_GATEWAY_MODELS`.
- Personal providers: visitors can add their own provider key or their own AI Gateway in the browser and use personal models, including image generation.
- Image generation and editing inside conversations, with up to 4 reference images (FLUX.2, OpenAI Images, Gemini image output).
- Documents (Workers AI `toMarkdown`) and web pages as context for any chat model.
- Read-only Cloudflare AI Search knowledge bases (RAG) with citations.
- Model layout: hide, group and reorder models; voice input and read-aloud; token usage ledger with estimated cost.
- Conversations stored locally in IndexedDB, exportable and importable as JSON.
- Optional shared access password (`APP_PASSWORD`); installable as a PWA that opens offline.

## 中文简介

Cloudflare AI Web 是一个开源、可自部署的 AI 对话平台，基于 Cloudflare Workers AI 与 Cloudflare AI Gateway 构建。一份代码可部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Vercel 或 Docker，服务端无状态，聊天记录保存在访客浏览器本地。

- 使用 Cloudflare 账号实时模型目录中的 Workers AI 模型。
- 通过 AI Gateway 接入外部模型（BYOK、Unified Billing、Gateway Route）。
- 访客可在浏览器里配置自己的 provider Key 或 AI Gateway（Personal Provider）。
- 会话内生图与改图，最多 4 张参考图。
- 文档解析、网页提取，以及 Cloudflare AI Search 知识库检索（RAG）与引用展示。
- 模型隐藏、分组与排序；语音输入与朗读；Token 用量与费用估算。
- 可设置访问密码；可安装为 PWA，离线也能打开。

- [源码与部署说明](https://github.com/Jazee6/cloudflare-ai-web)
